task_instance: Run the full access-review workflow on a sample HR roster and account export: diff the roster against the export (step 1), check a completed review campaign for coverage/self-review/unremoved-revokes (step 2), and map the combined findings to SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls as auditor evidence (step 3).
evidence: All three bundled stdlib scripts and example CSVs were present next to SKILL.md; copied scripts and the example roster/accounts/campaign CSVs into the work directory as hr_roster.csv, accounts.csv, campaign.csv. Imports are stdlib only (argparse, csv, datetime, io, json, statistics, sys, os) - no network. Step 1: 'python3 access_diff.py --roster hr_roster.csv --accounts accounts.csv --inactive-days 90 --privileged-review-days 90 --as-of 2026-10-31 --output json' exited 4 (BLOCKED) and wrote diff.json with verdict BLOCKED, population 5 people/7 accounts, 3 BLOCKER findings (LEAVER_ENABLED x2, LEAVER_USED_AFTER_EXIT) plus HIGH/MEDIUM, each mapped to ISO27001/SOC2/NIST/PCI/HIPAA controls. Step 2: 'python3 access_review_campaign.py --decisions campaign.csv --population accounts.csv --remediation-days 10 --close-date 2026-10-20 --output json' exited 4 (INCOMPLETE) and wrote campaign.json with codes POPULATION_GAP, REVOKE_NOT_REMOVED, SELF_REVIEW, UNDECIDED, LATE_DECISION, REVOKE_PENDING. Step 3: 'python3 control_evidence_mapper.py --diff diff.json --campaign campaign.json --framework soc2,iso27001 --output json' exited 4 and wrote mapping.json with a per-control table (summary FAIL 5, EXCEPTIONS 1, NO_EXCEPTIONS 1, NOT_COVERED 2), each control carrying title, status, auditor_tests and evidence_to_keep. Deliverables verified by parsing the three JSON outputs; blocking exit codes and finding contents match the behaviour the SKILL.md documents. Files produced in work dir: diff.json, campaign.json, mapping.json.
